Press [XBoxB_Btn_Y] to repair the Mako. This uses omni-gel.
Press [XBoxB_Btn_Y] to use medi-gel and regain health during combat. Put points into the First Aid skill to increase the amount of health regained from each medi-gel use.
Your targeting reticle will autolock on nearby enemies. It will change color once it is locked on.
Your attacks will aim at autolocked targets even if your reticle isn't focused on them.
Toxic damage reduces the amount of health you regain from medi-gel. Put points in Medicine to offset the effects of Toxic Damage.
When STORMING, watch the meter at the bottom left of the screen to avoid becoming fatigued.
Throwing a grenade beside an enemy in cover can be brutally effective.
The Power Wheel lets you use your special abilities. Press [XBoxB_Btn_RB] to bring up the Power Wheel during combat.
Don’t stay in cover too long or enemies will charge your position.
Equip each member of your squad with weapons they are trained to use.
Tap [XBoxB_Btn_LB] to equip your previous weapon without bringing up the Weapon Wheel.
Tap the [XBoxB_Btn_RB] to activate your mapped power without bringing up the Power Wheel.
The Weapon Wheel lets you switch weapon types in combat. Press and hold [XBoxB_Btn_LB] to bring up the Weapon Wheel.
Firing from a crouched position improves accuracy. Click [XBoxB_Btn_L3] to crouch or stand.
Press [XBoxB_Btn_A] to rifle-butt enemies at close range. Be careful: enemies can do the same to you, and some of them are far stronger than humans!
Use the Tactics HUD to set up combos for your squad. Have one squad member Lift a target while another one uses Throw to hurl your enemy across the room.
Set up combos for your squad with the Tactics HUD. Use Singularity to draw enemies into a tight group, then finish them off with a grenade!
Remember to hold [XBoxB_Btn_LB] to bring up the Weapon Wheel if you want to switch weapons.
Soldiers can spend points to gain skill in every weapon, unlocking the Marksman, Carnage, Overkill and Assassination abilities.
Adepts are biotic specialists with access to abilities like Lift, Throw and Singularity.
Engineers are tech experts with skill in Electronics, Decryption, and First Aid. They can gain abilities like Hacking and Overload.
Infiltrators combine combat and tech talents. Use the Tactics HUD to access their special abilities as you unlock them.
Sentinels combine biotic and tech talents. Use the Tactics HUD to access their special abilities as you unlock them.
Vanguards combine biotic and combat talents. Use the Tactics HUD to access their special abilities as you unlock them.
Krogan Battlemasters are dangerous foes with access to a wide variety of weapons and biotic abilities.
Asari Scientists often have powerful biotic abilities.
Turian Agents are highly trained military operatives with expertise in tech and weapons.
Quarian Machinists have access to a wide range of tech talents and abilities.
Press [XBoxB_Btn_DPadL] or [XBoxB_Btn_DPadR] to send a squadmate forward to a targeted location.
Press [XBoxB_Btn_DPadL] or [XBoxB_Btn_DPadR] to order a squadmate to move to a point.
Press [XBoxB_Btn_DPadD] to rally your squad and have them regroup around you.
Press [XBoxB_Btn_DPadU] to have your entire squad attack the highlighted target.
Send a squadmate forward to a targeted location by pressing [XBoxB_Btn_DPadL] or [XBoxB_Btn_DPadR].
Have a squadmate take cover at a location by pressing [XBoxB_Btn_DPadL] or [XBoxB_Btn_DPadR].
Rally your squad and have them regroup around you by pressing [XBoxB_Btn_DPadD].
Order your entire squad to attack a targeted enemy by pressing [XBoxB_Btn_DPadU].
Geth have advanced shielding to protect against gunfire, but they are vulnerable to biotic or melee attacks.
Geth snipers paint their enemies with targeting beams for a few seconds before firing. Use this time to run for cover!
Geth repair drones will heal other geth during a battle. Go for the repair drones first!
Flying creatures like drones are immune to Lift and Throw because of the mass effect fields they use to hover.
Geth stalkers use beams that can damage your shields, disable your powers and abilities and overheat your weapon.
Some enemies, like geth ghosts and geth primes, emit jamming signals. This blocks enemy units from appearing on your radar. Kill the jammer to remove this effect.
Krogan have high regeneration and a natural resistance to biotics. Luckily they are vulnerable to tech attacks like Neural Shock.
Krogan often go into a rage when wounded, charging directly towards their enemy.
Krogan have powerful melee attacks that will quickly kill any foe who gets too close. Keep your distance!
Krogan have powerful regeneration abilities. Sometimes they go down only to get back up again a few seconds later!
Asari are highly resistant to biotic and tech attacks. Gunfire works quite well against them, however.
Damping mines can prevent asari and other biotics from using their powers against you.
Rachni are resistant to biotic attacks and immune to most tech attacks. Luckily, they are vulnerable to gunfire.
Husks and creepers are resistant to damage, but must get close to you before they can attack. Try to keep your distance.
Husks and creepers will discharge special attacks if they get within melee range. Try to engage them at a distance.
Lift, Throw, Stasis and Neural Shock are all effective weapons to use against husks and creepers.
Gunfire and tech attacks are highly ineffective against husks and creepers. Try using biotic attacks to keep them at bay.
Replies on the right side of the conversation wheel generally progress you towards the end of a dialog.
Replies on the left side of the conversation wheel will often let you learn additional information from the speaker.
Replies on the bottom half of the conversation wheel tend to be more confrontational, and will sometimes earn you Renegade points.
Replies on the top half of the conversation wheel tend to be more agreeable, and will sometimes earn you Paragon points.
Spending points in Charm or Intimidate will open up new dialog options. Selecting these can earn you Paragon or Renegade points.
Press [UI_XBoxB_Btn_X] to skip immediately to the next line of dialog during a conversation.
Press [UI_XBoxB_Btn_A] to cue up your responses during dialog. You will reply as soon as the other person finishes talking.
Selecting a reply and pressing [UI_XBoxB_Btn_X] will make Shepard respond immediately, cutting off the dialog of the other speaker.
A high Renegade score will open up new slots in your Intimidate skill.
A high Paragon score will open up new slots in your Charm skill.
Talk to your squad members on the Normandy to learn their backstories.
Unity uses medi-gel to revive fallen squad members during combat. You must spend points in Spectre Training to unlock Unity on the Tactics HUD.
Stasis can give you a chance to regroup or seek cover by neutralizing an enemy for a few seconds.
Use Neural Shock to disable organic enemies for several seconds. Neural Shock will not work on synthetics like the geth.
Hold [XBoxB_Btn_RB] to bring up the Power Wheel and use the Shield Boost ability during combat to restore lost shields.
The Power Wheel lets you use your talents and powers. Hold [XBoxB_Btn_RB] to bring up the Power Wheel in combat.
Marksman will only appear on the Tactics HUD for squad members armed with pistols.
Carnage will only appear on the Tactics HUD for squad members armed with shotguns.
Overkill will only appear on the Tactics HUD for squad members armed with assault rifles.
Assassination will only appear on the Tactics HUD for squad members armed with sniper rifles.
The Adrenaline Burst ability instantly recharges all your other talents.
AI Hacking will turn a synthetic enemy against its own squad. AI Hacking has no effect on organic enemies.
Unlock the Overload ability, then use the Tactics HUD to launch it against your foes. This will temporarily damage their shields and armor.
Unlock the Sabotage ability then use the Tactics HUD to launch it against your enemies. This will temporarily disable their weapons.
Unlock the Damping ability then use the Tactics HUD to launch it against your enemies, temporarily disabling their tech and biotic powers.
Squad members with biotic Throw can use the Tactics HUD to toss opponents backwards, violently slamming them into objects and walls.
Squad members with biotic Lift can use the Tactics HUD to lift enemies high into the air, hampering their ability to fight and damaging them when they fall back to the floor.
Squad members with Stasis can use the Tactics HUD to temporarily disable a single opponent. Enemies trapped in Stasis are immune to all other attacks.
The Warp ability makes all attacks against the target do extra damage.
The Singularity ability can be used to draw enemies out of cover or suck them all into the center of a room for a devastating follow-up attack.
Damping, Sabotage and Overload are proximity mines. When they detonate all enemies caught in the radius of the blast will be affected.
Squad members with biotic Barrier can use the Tactics HUD to make them virtually immune to enemy gunfire.
Adjust combat difficulty under Gameplay in the Options menu on the Mission Computer.
Target Assist under Gameplay in the Options menu can be adjusted to change the sensitivity of your weapons' auto-lock feature.
You can adjust tactics for your squad by changing Squad Power Usage under Gameplay in the Options menu.
Turn subtitles on or off under Gameplay in the Options menu.
Graphics and sound settings can be adjusted under the Options menu on the Mission Computer.
Film grain and Motion Blur can be adjusted under Graphics in the Options menu.
Balance your squad with a mix of combat, tech and biotic skills.
You can climb up on some ledges by approaching them and pressing [XBoxB_Btn_A].
Specialized ammo upgrades are available that do bonus damage to organics and synthetics. Match your equipment to your opposition.
Equipment upgrades can be swapped at any time. Don't wait to return to the Normandy to add new upgrades you find.
